result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: the 'Fastest near you' carousel cards are vertically misaligned, with the middle card offset downward from its neighbors.

issues.description: The cards in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel are vertically misaligned: the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card image sits noticeably lower than the 'Green Bowl Poké' and third card images, and its title/delivery text are offset down compared to the neighboring items, breaking the row's top and baseline alignment.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel items the same container height and top alignment, remove any extra top margin/padding from the middle card, and align card images, time badges, titles, and delivery text to a common baseline.
